```json
{
  "up": "Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.

Join molecule_dictionary -> compound_records on molregno -> activities on record_id -> assays on assay_id -> target_dictionary on tid.
Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno as INNER JOIN (SMILES must be present).
Join docs on activities.doc_id.

Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL222', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_units = 'nM', activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL, (docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL).

Do not deduplicate — keep every qualifying activity row.

Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism."
}
```
